title: Analysis or Tests Exception
description: In the case of articles other than those subject to speedy or natural decay, the provisions of clause (c) of sub-section (2) of section 38 apply mutatis mutandis to analysis or tests

content.general_rule: In the case of articles subject to speedy or natural decay, the Director-General or such other officer may dispose of the article in such manner as may be prescribed, without referring it for analysis or test
content.exception: In the case of articles other than the articles subject to speedy or natural decay, the provisions contained in clause (c) of sub-section (2) of section 38 shall mutatis mutandis apply in relation to analysis or tests
conditions: the articles are other than those subject to speedy or natural decay
the provisions of clause (c) of sub-section (2) of section 38 (sealing samples and sending them to the appropriate laboratory for analysis or test) apply mutatis mutandis
